title: 2.5 Organization of Computer Systems
description: CPU, memory, storage, input/output, motherboard, bus, OS, and software

questions.question: What is the CPU commonly called?
options: C. The eye of the computer
A. The brain of the computer
B. The foot of the computer
D. The ear of the computer
questions.correctAnswer: A. The brain of the computer

questions.question: Which two units make up the Central Processing Unit?
What is the function of the Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU)?
What is the function of the Control Unit (CU)?
options: A. Manages instructions and data flow
questions.correctAnswer: A. Manages instructions and data flow

questions.question: What type of memory is RAM?
What is the main purpose of RAM?
options: A. Temporary storage while the computer is running
questions.correctAnswer: A. Temporary storage while the computer is running

questions.question: What type of memory is ROM?
What does ROM store?
options: A. Permanent instructions such as boot-up instructions
questions.correctAnswer: A. Permanent instructions such as boot-up instructions

questions.question: Which of the following is used for long-term data storage?
Which of the following is an input device?
Which of the following is an output device?
What is the function of the motherboard?
options: A. Connects and allows communication between all components
questions.correctAnswer: A. Connects and allows communication between all components

questions.question: What are expansion cards used for?
Which of the following is an example of an expansion card?
What is the function of the bus system?
options: A. Transfers data and instructions between components
questions.correctAnswer: A. Transfers data and instructions between components

questions.question: What is an operating system?
options: A. Software that manages resources and controls hardware
questions.correctAnswer: A. Software that manages resources and controls hardware

questions.question: What does software refer to in a computer system?
options: A. Programs and applications running on the computer
questions.correctAnswer: A. Programs and applications running on the computer

questions.question: True or False: RAM is a non-volatile memory.
True or False: ROM stores permanent boot-up instructions.
True or False: The CPU consists of the ALU and the Control Unit.
